headline: BARRICK LAUNCHES $3B BUYBACK After Q1 Earnings Surge 256% — North American Spinoff Targeted by Year-End
snippet: Barrick Mining beat Q1 2026 consensus estimates with adjusted EPS of $0.98—up 180% year-over-year on record gold prices—and authorized a new $3 billion share buyback program over 12 months. The company also confirmed plans to spin out its North American assets, including the Nevada JV and Fourmile discovery, into a separately listed company targeted for year-end 2026.

headline: SILVER SURGES 6% TO $85.5/OZ — Hits Near Two-Month High as Strait of Hormuz Closure Fuels Inflation Fears
snippet: Silver jumped over 6% to $85.5 an ounce on Monday as prolonged Strait of Hormuz disruption kept oil prices elevated and sustained inflation concerns, driving safe-haven and industrial-metal demand. The move extends silver's year-to-date gain to over 150%, with the Silver Institute forecasting a 67 million-ounce structural deficit for 2026—the sixth straight year of supply shortfall.

headline: 7,900 g/t SILVER AT COBALT: Brixton Metals Hits Blistering High-Grade at Historic Ontario Camp
snippet: Brixton Metals drilled 13.0m at 594 g/t silver—including a high-grade core of 0.5m at 7,900 g/t—at its Langis Silver Project in historic Cobalt, Ontario in its fourth 2026 result batch. The company has now completed 13,845m across 68 holes this year and plans to add a second drill rig in mid-May as it advances toward a maiden resource estimate.

headline: Faraday Copper Drills 36m at 0.81% Cu From Surface in Arizona — Near-Surface Oxide Target Keeps Growing
snippet: Faraday Copper's (TSX-V: FDY) 19-hole Phase IV program at Copper Creek, Arizona returned 36m at 0.81% Cu from surface at Copper Giant and 28m at 0.58% Cu plus 0.10% Mo from 46m at Marsha. Results confirm broad near-surface oxide and secondary sulphide mineralization amenable to heap leach processing, extending the potential open-pit resource footprint.

headline: CHINA BANS SULPHURIC ACID EXPORTS — Chilean Copper Output Exposed as Middle East War Squeezes Global Supply Chain
snippet: China halted sulphuric acid exports starting May 2026, cutting off over one million tonnes of annual supply that Chile depends on for copper heap leach and SX-EW operations—a shortage compounded by Middle East war disruptions to sulphur supply routes through the Strait of Hormuz. Chilean copper production had already fallen 6% year-over-year in Q1 2026, and analysts warn the acid crunch will deepen that decline through the second half.

headline: GERMANIUM SURPRISE: Honey Badger Silver Finds Critical-Mineral Upside at Prairie Creek Silver-Zinc Project
snippet: Honey Badger Silver (TSX-V: TUF) announced preliminary evidence of high-grade germanium potential at its recently acquired Prairie Creek Silver-Zinc-Lead Project in the Northwest Territories, where new analytical methods identified the critical mineral currently priced above US$8,000/kg—more than double last year. Though early-stage, germanium adds a potentially significant by-product revenue stream to an already large, fully permitted underground project.

headline: Tocvan Ventures: 5,300m Drilled at Gran Pilar, Community Land Deal Signed, Pilot Plant Equipment Ordered
snippet: Tocvan Ventures (TSX-V: TOC) reported 5,300+ metres drilled of its fully funded 20,000m program at Gran Pilar Gold-Silver in Sonora, Mexico, with 21 holes pending assay including three following up on the new El Mezquite discovery. The company also signed a long-term community land access agreement and ordered processing plant equipment for its fully permitted 50,000-tonne pilot mine.

headline: Silver One Completes Candelaria Geotechnical Drill and ZTEM Survey — Exploration RC Drilling Starts Late May
snippet: Silver One Resources (TSX-V: SVE) completed geotechnical drilling (1,874m in 9 holes), auger drilling across both historic leach pads (1,414m in 56 holes), and a property-wide ZTEM airborne EM survey at its Candelaria silver project in Nevada. Exploration RC drilling targeting resource expansion begins late May with a second rig arriving in July, as the company targets 2026 prefeasibility study completion.

headline: Gold SWOT: China Imports 790+ Tonnes Silver in Early 2026 — Sixth Straight Structural Deficit Year Taking Shape
snippet: GoldSeek's Gold SWOT analysis highlights that China imported over 790 tonnes of silver in early 2026—driven substantially by solar panel manufacturing—as the market heads toward its sixth straight structural supply deficit. The analysis argues silver demand is fundamentally sound at decade-high prices, supported by record industrial consumption and tightening physical inventory in London.

headline: Rare Earths Americas Surges 26% Above $19 IPO Price — $63M Raised to Advance U.S. Heavy Rare Earth Discovery
snippet: Rare Earths Americas (NYSE: REA) raised $63.3 million in an upsized IPO priced at $19 per share and surged more than 26% above its offering price on its NYSE American debut on May 6. The exploration-stage company is advancing the Shiloh heavy rare earth project in Georgia—targeting elements critical for permanent magnets and defense—alongside two projects in Brazil.

headline: LITHIUM MARKET FLIPS TO DEFICIT: Energy Storage Boom Drives 80,000-Tonne Shortfall Forecast — Morgan Stanley
snippet: A boom in grid-scale battery storage has flipped the lithium demand outlook, with Morgan Stanley projecting an 80,000-tonne LCE deficit in 2026 versus an expected 61,000-tonne surplus in 2025. Energy storage is forecast to represent 31% of total lithium demand in 2026—up from 23% in 2025—with sector demand growing 55% year-over-year as data center and EV build-out accelerates.
